HP Laptops Price List in India

HP is a well-known American multinational software and computer company with its headquarters in Palo Alto, California. The brand offers laptops in every price range, from affordable basic models to mid-range and flagship laptops with the latest technology.

For students or general users, HP has basic and compatible laptops, while video editors and gamers may prefer HP laptops with NVIDIA graphics card, increased RAM, and compatible SSD storage for faster data transfer. Artists and designers may find HP touchscreen 4K display laptops easier to work with. It is recommended to go for a warranty-backed laptop for extra safety and peace of mind.

To help you choose the best HP laptop, we have compiled a list of HP laptops with varying prices according to their specs and size. With detailed specifications for each laptop, selecting the right one for you will be simpler and hassle-free. This price list was last updated on August 15, 2025.
